title: Predicting Residential Rents in Dakar Using Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.30865v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dakar's residential rental market remains poorly documented despite its economic and social importance: 54.4% of households are renters, compared to 23.3% nationally. This study develops a complete machine learning pipeline to predict residential rents in Dakar, from data collection to model interpretation. An original dataset of 1,507 rental listings was built through systematic web scraping and a documented cleaning pipeline, then enriched with four purpose-built features, including a luxury score and a keyword-based quality score. Five models were compared: linear regression, Random Forest (baseline), XGBoost, and LightGBM optimized through Bayesian optimization with Optuna, using leakage-free KFold target encoding for location. The optimized XGBoost model achieved the best performance with an $R^2$ of 0.847, an MAE of 210,902 XOF, and an RMSE of 324,195 XOF. translated_title: 使用机器学习预测达喀尔住宅租金
translated_abstract: 尽管达喀尔住宅租赁市场具有重要的经济和社会意义，但其相关记录仍然匮乏：达喀尔54.4%的家庭为租房者，而全国这一比例仅为23.3%。本研究开发了一个完整的机器学习流程来预测达喀尔的住宅租金，涵盖从数据收集到模型解释的全过程。研究通过系统的网络爬虫和有记录的清洗流程构建了一个包含1,507条租房信息的原创数据集，并使用四个专门构建的特征对其进行丰富，包括豪华度评分和基于关键词的质量评分。研究比较了五种模型：线性回归、随机森林（基线）、XGBoost，以及通过Optuna贝叶斯优化调优的LightGBM，并对位置信息采用无泄漏的KFold目标编码。优化后的XGBoost模型取得了最佳性能，R²为0.847，平均绝对误差（MAE）为210,902西非法郎（XOF），均方根误差（RMSE）为324,195西非法郎。特征重要性通过XGBoost原生增益和SHAP值进行评估。
tldr: 本研究构建了从数据采集到模型解释的完整机器学习流程来预测达喀尔住宅租金，优化后的XGBoost模型达到R²为0.847的最佳性能，并利用SHAP值揭示了关键特征的重要性。
en_tdlr: This study develops a complete machine learning pipeline for predicting residential rents in Dakar, with an optimized XGBoost model achieving the best performance (R² = 0.847) and SHAP values used to interpret feature importance.
